PACKAGE

Self-Contained

Every message is a complete .ppp document — Header + Body + Receipt

LOCK

Verifiable

Receipt = TrustChain proof + Sigstore anchoring. Immutable audit trail.

GLOBE

Routable

Endpoint URI in header enables mesh routing across networks.

TAG

Versioned

Explicit protocol versioning. Backward compatible evolution.

SATELLITE

Transport Agnostic

HTTP, WebSocket, QUIC, libp2p, email, carrier pigeon.

PUZZLE

Extensible

Extensible body schema. Per-endpoint schemas via JSON Schema.
